item.title: Morning Weather for Tuesday, September 08
item.description: Good morning! Here is your weather report for Tuesday, September 8. Tuesday already. Well done for a good start! Here in Shanghai, the day will be damp with light drizzle. The high will be 30 degrees, and the low will be 23 degrees. The chance of rain is 61 percent. Remember to take an umbrella with you! It's a puddle day! Let's put on our wellies and see how many puddles we can jump in. And here's a look ahead: tomorrow will be damp with light drizzle, with a high of 29 degrees. Something to think about: what colour is today, do you think? That's your weather report. See you tomorrow!
